t2i_prompt: A 1440 px wide desktop web section, flat straight-on UI mockup, editorial magazine spread. Warm limestone background. Left half: an oversized stacked all-caps navy headline, below it <CONTENT> as numbered specification rows set in monospace figures with small-caps labels and hairline rules, stepping slightly right like a staircase, the last row larger in steel blue. Right half: one striking soft 3D render of a translucent frosted glass pipe looping into a knot, a deep navy ribbon band running diagonally out of it with an angled label. Thin leader lines connect rows to the sculpture. Generous negative space, square corners, no device frame.
signature_idea: The limits table becomes an editorial staircase of numbers that descends into a glass pipe loop, ending on a highlighted guaranteed outlet value.
strengths: numbers lead: limits in mono with units and references are exactly what QA readers scan for
guaranteed outlet row as highlighted payoff is a strong sales point
warm limestone plus navy reads calm and premium
leader lines tie data to equipment
weaknesses: headline is heavy bold caps, off-brand vs Geist light sentence case
glass knot sculpture is abstract and decorative, not a real PP loop
'GUARANTEED' ribbon feels like marketing hype for an engineering audience
leader lines go to arbitrary points on the sculpture
brand_fit_why: Palette, mono figures and square corners match, but the bold all-caps headline and glossy glass sculpture break the light, precise, calm line-art brand.
